run_fft_1d_transform: run a 1D FFT on an array with numpy.fft.fft from array_api_compat
run_ifft_1d_transform: run a 1D inverse FFT on an array with numpy.fft.ifft from array_api_compat
run_fftn_n_dimensional: run an N-dimensional FFT on a multi-dimensional array with numpy.fft.fftn
run_rfft_real_input: run a real-input FFT preserving float32 dtype with numpy.fft.rfft
run_fftshift_frequency: run fftshift to reorder FFT output with zero-frequency component centered
